pages.mainText: Connect Job openings Scroll to content Careers Strategic Growth Director (New Business) Commercial · Manchester · Fully Remote All jobs Mobysoft - Cutting Edge Technology with a Social Purpose Mobysoft provides software and data driven insights that help social housing providers manage rent arrears and drive efficiencies within repairs and maintenance operations, leading to improved services to tenants.We offer our customers the latest award winning, cutting edge AI technology in the form of our industry leading RentSense and RepairSense platfoms that not only allows organisations make huge cost savings, but allows them to focus on the job of sustaining tenancies and keeping tenants in homes they can be proud of. At Mobysoft and you’ll get the opportunity to work with an outstanding team with an award-winning suite of products, work in a challenging and fun environment and develop a rewarding career. More importantly, you’ll help make a difference to the lives of millions of people residing in social housing.Our ‘Tech for Good’ ethos underpins everything we do here at Mobysoft, meaning that our responsibility transcends profitability. We are committed to initiatives that positively impact communities and the planet in the long run.Make a career defining decision and join us at Mobysoft. Our teams Technology Commercial Professional Services All Our Teams Working at Mobysoft Technology for GoodFounded in 2003, Mobysoft is a trusted provider of AI data analytics platforms tailored for the social housing sector. Our technology empowers social landlords with a suite of intelligent systems designed to enhance income-collection processes, benefiting residents and organisations alike. Our key solutions include RentSense, RepairSense, Intelligent Automation and Former Tenant Arrears Essentials, each addressing critical aspects of the social housing sector.Our industry leading RentSense product protects at-risk tenants by supporting social housing providers to proactively manage rent arrears by identifying those cases that require action and enabling housing officers to enact early intervention, ultimately resulting in fewer evictions and more people being supported to manage their tenancies.RepairSense functions in a similar way, only instead of harnessing the power of data to prevent rent arrears from being accrued, this powerful AI powered platform analyses data relating to repairs jobs, allowing proactive maintenance to be carried out and preventing problematic repeat visits.These two core products have transformed the social housing sector’s approach to debt prevention, repairs, and damp and mould, driving better outcomes for millions of tenants across the UK. Knowing that we are truly making a difference is the biggest driver for our team and one that runs through the heart of our business. At Mobysoft, we take a hands-on approach where everybody is involved with no egos. We’re a truly collaborative business and one that values the knowledge and experience of each and every member of the team. It’s our people that have made Mobysoft the success story that it is and continues to be and if you’re someone with drive, passion and who’s always striving to innovate, we’d love for you to be a part of our ongoing journey. Rewarding Success Benefits Health & Wellbeing 25 days annual leave (increasing to 28 after 3 years service)Salary sacrifice additional leave schemeAnnual Specsavers vouchersPrivate healthcare via BupaLife Cover – 4x salaryEnhanced parental leave and new baby hamperCycle to work scheme24/7 Employee Assistance ProgrammeWinter flu jab contribution Team Building & Recognition New starter welcome meals with your teamQuarterly employee events including Summer & Christmas partyRegular team communication updatesAnnual individual training budgetQuarterly employee recognition awardsManager “On the Spot” Rewards ProgrammeMilestone birthday cakesGenerous £3,000 employee referral schemeLong service recognition awardsCompany performance-based bonus scheme Ambitious growth Working in a growing business means career progression and opportunities. Professional development is widely supported at Mobysoft and we'll create a development plan just right for you. Recognising our talents We're big on shouting about our team and the great things they do - we have quarterly recognition awards to celebrate our talent and the great things we do for our customers Our values At Mobysoft how we work together is as important as the work we do. Our Values - Human - Customer Centric - Ambition - Team Work - Driven to Succeed See What Our Employees Say About Mobysoft... One of the best things about the role is making sure the customer gets the best RentSense experience they can have. I started working at Mobysoft in 2015 as a Customer Success Manager, over the years I have built great relationships with my customers, this helps me to understand how they work as a team and how RentSense can help them. Constant RentSense reviews and officer meetings helps us keep in touch with the ever-moving challenges our customers face. The success of RentSense means new customers join the Mobysoft family constantly and it is great seeing them start the journey and watching them change and benefit from the system. When you hear from our customers on how RentSense is helping reduce the workload and help reduce their arrears is amazing. I have had several jobs before working at Mobysoft including a company that did SAS (software as a service) for the police force - a programme that helped them with large projects, this got me on the CSM ladder. Working at Mobysoft is like a big family and no hierarchy, one big team and one goal of Customer Success. Tracy Customer Success Manager One of the best aspects of my role is the opportunity to work alongside so many passionate people who are helping customers succeed. We are always looking to evolve and create new content for customers and prospects – every day is different. For me, the best things about working here are the people, the culture, the product and our customers. Everyone’s approachable and has time to support one another. The product is unique and delivers real measurable value to our customers – our customers are always our biggest supporters, advocating our software and services to their peers. Living in Manchester I have access to the tram so the commute is easy because of our great location. Outside of work, I enjoy spending time with family, camping, climbing, running, going to gigs and listening to music. Adrian Marketing Director The best thing about my role is the challenging work I do and leading the systems team. I focus most of my time on cloud infrastructure, implementation of customers and their various specifications. Having worked based in Manchester for 7 years at Mobysoft, this year I relocated to Birmingham to be with my family. The introduction of flexible working has transformed the way we work together and improved everyone's work life balance and means I can walk my dog Charlie each day. Outside work I’m a fan of formula one, football and gaming. Alan Systems Operations Team Lead My role at Mobysoft is incredibly exciting and always evolving, so this is difficult to articulate into just one paragraph! But essentially, my role is to accelerate product development by conducting analysis, gaining insights and communicating findings to the data function. This specialisation saves colleagues' time and results in improved products for our clients, as important insights are not missed in the rush to develop new offerings. Furthermore, I work on smaller scale (but still highly important!) projects such as the RepairSense ROI Calculator. This will be a tool for the sales team to show clients their expected cost savings from upgrading to RepairSense, and will be available within a mobile app for quick access/availability. I started my career working in the civil service, as an Inventory Manager and it was here that I fell in love with data. I knew Data Analysis was what I wanted to do, so I began learning Python, Tableau and SQL in my spare time, before landing a Data Analyst role at a publisher specialising in Tech/Consumer Finance. Following 2 years with a TV Streaming software provider, I was sure that software was where I wanted to be, which bought me to Mobysoft following a move up to Manchester. My favourite part of the job is the techy side of the role. I love developing well designed and effective dashboards, from the beginnings in SQL to the finished product, with Tableau being where I have most of my experience. I find it incredibly satisfying to solve problems like this, so I am very lucky this is what I do for my living! Matt Data Analyst Manchester - The Northern Powerhouse Manchester is recognised as the UK’s fastest growing and most economically productive city and one of Europe’s largest creative, digital and technology clusters. The Manchester office is based on Portland Street less than a 10 minute walk from Manchester Oxford Road Station and Manchester Piccadilly Station. Parking is also available nearby.
